reasoning_content: The dearmor succeeded, and apt update was also executed. postgresql-15 is now a candidate at 15.19. Exit code 141 is probably due to SIGPIPE from the `head -1` against a binary file... actually it's the exit code of the pipeline. Let's check the current state and install postgresql-15 and postgis.

action.command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get install -y -qq postgresql-15 postgresql-15-postgis-3 > /tmp/pg_install.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; tail -2 /tmp/pg_install.log; pg_lsclusters 2>/dev/null
